command:
# Independent auditor byte audit of the refreshed vendor tree (pin 6de59de1).
# 1. Every vendored file equals the pinned blob, or the pinned blob plus its ledger patch.
# 2. Every pinned blob id is cross-checked against GitHub's own tree API for the
#    same commit, walking from the commit's root tree (public, unauthenticated).
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, urllib.request
V = 'vendor/tcg-engines'; SRC = '.local/upstream-2026-10-13/repository'
REV = '6de59de1c203827edc1bc6faa1bc6184cd126a5f'
lock = json.load(open(V + '/upstream.lock.json'))
assert lock['revision'] == REV, lock['revision']
assert json.load(open('scripts/engine/selection.json'))['revision'] == REV
head = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', SRC, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
assert head == REV, 'pinned checkout HEAD ' + head
def blob(path):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', SRC, 'cat-file', 'blob', REV + ':' + path], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout
def gitsha(b):
    return hashlib.sha1(b'blob %d\0' % len(b) + b).hexdigest()
sha = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
ids = [p['id'] for p in lock['patches']]
assert ids == ['P%03d' % i for i in range(1, 60)], ids
patches = {}
for p in lock['patches']:
    patches.setdefault(p['path'], []).append(p)
identical = patched = 0
for row in lock['files']:
    pinned = blob(row['upstream_path']); local = open(V + '/' + row['path'], 'rb').read()
    assert gitsha(pinned) == row['git_blob'] and sha(pinned) == row['upstream_sha256'], row['path']
    assert sha(local) == row['sha256'] and len(local) == row['bytes'], row['path']
    if row['path'] in patches:
        text = pinned.decode('utf8')
        for p in patches[row['path']]:
            assert text.count(p['before']) == 1, ('anchor', p['id'])
            text = text.replace(p['before'], p['after'])
            assert open(V + '/' + p['original_path'], 'rb').read() == pinned, ('original', p['id'])
        assert text.encode('utf8') == local, ('patched bytes', row['path'])
        patched += 1
    else:
        assert local == pinned, ('changed unpatched', row['path'])
        identical += 1
listed = {r['path'] for r in lock['files']}
assert set(patches) <= listed
present = set()
for d, _, fs in os.walk(V + '/upstream'):
    for f in fs:
        present.add(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(d, f), V))
assert present == listed, ('extra', sorted(present - listed)[:5], 'missing', sorted(listed - present)[:5])
for lic in lock['licenses']:
    b = blob(lic['upstream_path'])
    assert open(V + '/' + lic['path'], 'rb').read() == b and gitsha(b) == lic['git_blob'], lic['path']
tests = [t for t in lock['tests']]
assert len(tests) == 37 and all(('upstream/' + t) in listed and ('upstream/' + t) not in patches for t in tests)
assert all('/cards/' not in p['path'] and not p['path'].endswith('.test.ts') for p in lock['patches'])
assert 'seedrandom' not in lock['runtime_externals'] and lock['runtime_externals'] == ['@logtape/logtape', 'mutative']
# Old provenance originals that no longer belong to a ledger patch must not linger.
originals = {p['original_path'] for p in lock['patches']}
prov = {'provenance/' + n for n in os.listdir(V + '/provenance') if n != 'LORCANA_LICENSE.txt'}
assert prov == originals, ('provenance drift', sorted(prov ^ originals)[:5])
# GitHub cross-check of every pinned blob id and both licenses.
api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/TheCardGoat/tcg-engines'
calls = 0
def get(url):
    global calls; calls += 1
    with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'Accept': 'application/vnd.github+json', 'User-Agent': 'lorcana-audit'})) as r:
        return json.load(r)
commit = get(f'{api}/git/commits/{REV}')
cache = {'': commit['tree']['sha']}
def tree_sha(path):
    if path in cache: return cache[path]
    parent, _, name = path.rpartition('/')
    entries = get(f"{api}/git/trees/{tree_sha(parent)}")['tree']
    for e in entries: cache[(parent + '/' if parent else '') + e['path']] = e['sha']
    return cache[path]
github = {}
for top in ['submodules/lorcana/packages/lorcana/lorcana-engine', 'submodules/lorcana/packages/lorcana/lorcana-types', 'submodules/agnostic-simulator/packages/bot-core/src', 'submodules/agnostic-simulator/packages/card-model/src']:
    t = get(f'{api}/git/trees/{tree_sha(top)}?recursive=1')
    assert not t['truncated'], top
    for e in t['tree']:
        if e['type'] == 'blob': github[top + '/' + e['path']] = e['sha']
for path in ['LICENSE', 'submodules/lorcana/LICENSE']:
    github[path] = tree_sha(path)
assert commit['tree']['sha'] == subprocess.run(['git', '-C', SRC, 'rev-parse', REV + '^{tree}'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
for row in lock['files']:
    assert github.get(row['upstream_path']) == row['git_blob'], ('github blob mismatch', row['upstream_path'])
for lic in lock['licenses']:
    assert github.get(lic['upstream_path']) == lic['git_blob'], ('github license mismatch', lic['upstream_path'])
print(json.dumps({'revision': REV, 'files': len(listed), 'identical': identical, 'patched_files': patched, 'patches': len(ids),
                  'runtime_files': len(lock['runtime_files']), 'licenses': len(lock['licenses']), 'selected_tests_unchanged': len(tests),
                  'runtime_externals': lock['runtime_externals'], 'extra_or_missing': 0, 'github_blob_ids_matched': len(lock['files']) + len(lock['licenses']), 'github_api_calls': calls}))
print('PASS independent byte audit of the 361-file pin-6de59de1 closure and 59-patch ledger; every pinned blob id matches GitHub\'s tree for the commit')
